functional.title: Vendor master and invoices
functional.definition: Build CSV preview, explicit column mapping, SIREN validation and tenant-scoped deduplication. Save raw permitted values alongside parsed observations.

functional.title: Freshness and conflict cases
functional.definition: Implement a versioned clock-based policy and stable trigger coalescing per accepted supplier revision.

functional.title: Registry adapter and terms
functional.definition: Define provider discovery, quoted amount, metadata, source timing and lawful field retention. Implement a real eligible source and record environment evidence.

functional.title: Delegated spending and recovery
functional.definition: Bind the selected listing, amount, currency and grant to an intent. Use transactional reservations plus outbox, receipt matching and reconciliation.

functional.title: Field differences and decisions
functional.definition: Produce field-level deltas with source originals, effective dates and comparison rules. Apply an accepted decision using optimistic concurrency.

functional.title: AP inbox and sensitive exceptions
functional.definition: Build accessible case list, decision screen, exception routing and redacted evidence preview.

functional.title: Close, export and pilot evidence
functional.definition: Build paginated accepted-change export, spend reconciliation and pilot report of paid checks, unresolved items and analyst time.

nonfunctional.title: Replayable evidence
nonfunctional.definition: A reviewer can reproduce the outcome from the exact input revision, actor scope, persisted decision and redacted evidence reference after a process restart.

invariants.title: Vendor master and invoices
invariants.definition: An ambiguous match cannot link an invoice or open a paid refresh.

invariants.title: Freshness and conflict cases
invariants.definition: Replaying one import cannot create another billable trigger for that version.

invariants.title: Registry adapter and terms
invariants.definition: Every changed field identifies the source snapshot and applicable timestamp.

invariants.title: Delegated spending and recovery
invariants.definition: Every charge belongs to one refresh; a timed-out payment cannot trigger a second purchase automatically.

invariants.title: Field differences and decisions
invariants.definition: Only a current reviewed revision can become the accepted supplier snapshot.

invariants.title: AP inbox and sensitive exceptions
invariants.definition: Public company matching can never authorize a beneficiary-account change.

invariants.title: Close, export and pilot evidence
invariants.definition: Dismissed, unknown and superseded observations are excluded from accepted exports.
